analysis:
Examined all three primary analyses and all replayed metadata, patches and source against the canonical definition index and supplied TB-002/TB-011 details. CoordinatorClient.swift:120-141 injects a reconnect policy; CoordinatorClientState.swift:509-537 adds lock-protected session-duration and close-code recording. docs/architecture/components/provider.md:119-143 and changelog.d/provider-fast-reconnect.md:3-5 describe stable-session reset and randomized accelerated retries for coordinator close 1012. These changes affect availability (A-018) and connection turnover, not serving permission. Registration remains distinct from authorization under TB-002/TB-011; faster retries must not extend proof lifetime or bypass connection fencing (T-053).

No supported regression was identified in the replayed changes: recording numeric close codes exposes no prompt/key material, and the changed documentation does not claim resumed completions or renewed authorization. No supplied change establishes weakened encryption (T-008), cache isolation (T-041), model qualification, billing, fan-helper or add-on controls. The test analysis reports timing/re-registration checks, which cannot establish authorization correctness.

Material coverage limits remain: replay omits 10 reviewed units, including connection-loop and test source, and the production CoordinatorReconnectPolicy implementation is not supplied. Consequently the prior local questions cannot be fully reconciled. Further review should inspect CoordinatorReconnectPolicy.swift with CoordinatorClient+Connection.swift to verify bounded finite retry ranges, escalation for repeated failures, stable-session timing measured from registration rather than authorization, coordinator close-code attribution, and shutdown responsiveness. It should also confirm accelerated reconnect preserves old-request cancellation, socket-bound Apple replies and authorization invalidation (T-010/T-053). Missing implementations are unresolved contracts, not evidence of absent controls; no full-PR security clearance is implied.
